subject: Request: Combined trial top-up + discounted onramp for VentureLine POC — exec sign-off
messages:
From: Alex Gomez <agomez@ventureline.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Diane Park <dpark@ventureline.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot usage spike — ask for top-up + introductory discount

Hi Tessa,

Quick update from our end: last week we spiked past our allocated trial tokens running the multi‑agent summarization flows. Diane and I reviewed the usage and we’re still seeing strong signal — a 4x improvement in label throughput for the pilot cohort.

We have two asks so we can keep momentum into next quarter:
- A one‑time trial top‑up of $15,000 in free credits to finish a final set of integration tests and performance benchmarks.
- An introductory commercial discount (20% off list) for the first 6 months if we convert to a committed plan within 60 days.

We understand this is an exception request; we wanted to surface it early and get alignment on what level of approval you need. I attached our usage export and a short summary.

Would love to get this routed to your leadership for a quick decision — timing is tight to keep our internal roadmap on track.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Gomez
Lead ML Engineer, VentureLine
Attachments: VentureLine_Pilot_Usage.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Gomez <agomez@ventureline.ai>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 21 May 2028 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot usage spike — ask for top-up + introductory discount

Hi Alex — thanks for the context and the usage file, that’s helpful.

Short answer: we can do a combined concession (credit top‑up + introductory discount) but it requires exec + finance approval because it’s outside standard onboarding thresholds.

Proposed structure I want to put forward to leadership:
- One‑time $15K credit applied to the pilot account (applies only to trial tokens, expires 90 days after grant).
- 20% off list on the customer’s first 6 months if they sign a minimum 6‑month committed plan within 60 days of acceptance.
- Simple SOW addendum and a short mutual action plan to capture the acceptance criteria and usage milestones.

I’m looping Priyom and Marissa to get a rapid review. If approved, next steps are: SOW draft -> legal review (DocuSign) -> grant credit and apply promo code. I’ve attached a draft SOW template for the ask.

Tessa Morgan
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachments: VentureLine_SOW_draft.pdf (pdf)
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 22 May 2028 08:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Pilot usage spike — ask for top-up + introductory discount — exec approval request

Marissa / Aditya / Laura —

Forwarding VentureLine’s ask (below). TL;DR: strong product signal, small engineering team, time‑sensitive ramp. I recommend approving a conservatively sized combined concession to secure the committed conversion. Rationale:
- Upside: high likelihood to convert given current usage + engaged ML leadership. Forecasted ARR upside if converted: ~$180K ARR in 12 months with conservative usage estimates.
- Downside: $15K credit exposure + 20% promo on first 6 months; finance impact is modest relative to expected conversion.

Requesting approval for the following exception:
1) Approve one‑time $15,000 trial credit to be applied to the VentureLine pilot account (expires 90 days).
2) Approve a 20% introductory discount on the first 6 months of a committed plan (6‑month minimum).

Conditions:
- Legal sign SOW addendum and standard NBO T&Cs.
- Finance to confirm billing code and limit for the credit grant.
- We will require a light success metric: integration tests complete and the production verification run within 60 days (we'll capture in the mutual action plan).

Priyom, please add any commercial notes or counter‑levers. Laura — can you confirm the accounting treatment and whether we need a revenue deferral note for the credit?

Thanks,
Tessa
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 23 May 2028 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot usage spike — ask for top-up + introductory discount — exec approval request

Team — after quick review: I approve the combined concession with the conditions below.

Approved concession (conditional):
- Grant $12,000 of one‑time trial credit (reduced from requested $15K) to limit downside exposure. Credit expires 90 days.
- Approve 15% introductory discount (reduced from 20%) on the first 6 months of a minimum 6‑month committed plan.

Conditions / next steps:
1) Laura — confirm we can apply the $12K credit in billing and provide GL code; any material revenue deferral to be handled through finance ops.
2) Legal to sign the SOW addendum; include a termination clause tied to the success metric.
3) Tessa / Priyom — get VentureLine signoff on the mutual action plan by Friday 2028‑05‑26.
4) We will revisit the discount level if VentureLine converts to an annual commitment within 90 days.

Tessa — please send final SOW addendum (DocuSign link) and a concise email to Alex outlining approved items and timelines. Keep this to the minimum necessary concessions to protect ARR.

Marissa Cole
VP Sales | Redwood Inference
Attachments: pricing-summary-compare.xlsx (xlsx)
